description:
What if Unity Hub and GitHub Desktop had a Baby but its Adopted? Yeah..


What's new in v1.3.7 - UI Overhaul Update
🚀 New
- Credits Section in the Settings
- New Popup for existing users to shift to New UI, in Classic UI
- Contributors' names in Credit screen with their PRs displayed
🐛 Fixes
- Git's Pathspec errors
- Fixed Time tracker adding fake hours to the projects
✨ Improvements
- Removed Onboarding Tips
- Brought back categories in New UI
